title: Fully blocking Tor: the ATP toggle is not enough

tor-toggle.statement: Tor can be allowed or blocked as a P2P anonymizer protocol; content downloaded with Tor is encrypted and cannot be inspected.

quotes: Tor: Choose to Allow or Block the usage of Tor, a popular P2P anonymizer protocol. Content downloaded with Tor is encrypted, and therefore it cannot be inspected.

needs-firewall-rule.statement: To fully block Tor, set the Tor toggle to Block and also create a firewall filtering rule that blocks Tor as a network application. Blocking network applications requires Advanced Firewall.

quotes: To fully block Tor usage, you must set the Tor toggle to Block and then create a firewall filtering rule that blocks Tor as a network application. The ability to block network applications requires Advanced Firewall.
